description.value:
This staff is carved of golden birchwood, and its roughly patterned surface resembles tree bark. While wielding the staff, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Fortitude DC against attempts to [[/act reposition]], [[/act shove]], or [[/act trip]] you.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.
